data.about: • Expert in Controller Design, Mechatronics, Robotics, Vibrations Analysis & Acoustics, Controller Board (dSPACE, National Instrument, Microcontroller, Arduino & Raspberry Pi)• Proficient in Machine Learning, Statistical Analytics, Data Visualization, Pattern Recognition & Optimization• Experience in Real-time software on microprocessor-based systems and developing software in a Linux environment, Medical product development including hands-on experience with medical/surgical devices/instruments• Expert in programming with MATLAB, Simulink, Python, C++, LabVIEW, SQL• Engineering Softwares: COMSOL Multiphysics, SolidWorks, CATIA, ANSYS• Soft Skills: Leadership, Mentoring, Fast Learning, Self-supervising, Teamwork, Problem Solving

subComponents.title: Senior Software Engineer- Software Developer, Surgical Operation
subComponents.caption: Sep 2024 - Present · 1 yr 4 mos

description.text:
• Developed and implemented an adaptive robust estimator to reconstruct force measurements during strain‑gauge signal dropout, improving reliability of force feedback in robotic surgical manipulators.
• Developed low‑jerk trajectory generators and closed‑loop motion controllers in MATLAB/Simulink for robotic surgical stapler instruments, enabling smooth position, velocity, and acceleration tracking.
• Developed forward and inverse kinematics models for next‑generation wristed robotic surgical staplers, enabling precise maneuverability in confined anatomical spaces and supporting smooth, optimized motion through kinematics‑based optimization algorithms.
• Developed the next-gen surgical robot stapler instrument, enhancing surgical precision and performance.
• Contributed to Jacobians-based optimization, enhancing haptic feedback for better surgeon control and precision.
• Designed and integrated real-time embedded control software for precision-driven robotic manipulators.
• Conducted hardware-in-loop testing, ensuring seamless integration between control software and medical devices.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams (systems engineering, software, and validation) to define and review safety-critical software requirements.
• Led continuous improvement efforts in verification methods, enhancing system reliability and performance.
• Reviewed MATLAB/Simulink models, verifying compliance with precise standards for medical device software quality
• Participated in design reviews and contributed to the documentation of architecture, unit testing, and anomaly tracking.
• Integrated mechanical, electrical, and software components, particularly in an embedded, high-performance control environment.

subComponents.title: Senior Software Engineer - Test lead, Surgical Operation (Robotics)
subComponents.caption: Jun 2023 - Sep 2024 · 1 yr 3 mos

description.text:
• Test Lead for software release in surgical robot and leading software verification for FDA submission
• Provide technical leadership for the software verification engineering verifying the functionality of feedback control loop algorithms designed and developed in MATLAB/Simulink
• Lead a team verifying controls software for robotic manipulators and surgical instruments
• Lead a team integrating and testing new controller designs on hardware and with the rest of the robotic platform
• Conduct software and product hardware-in-loop testing and create model and prototypes
• Review teammates MATLAB/Simulink models and ensure that all software meets quality standards; prepare and participate in design reviews
• Document or participate in the documentation of the software including verification test plans and reports
• Lead the definition and implementation of different software testing techniques to increase test coverage in both automation and manual testing.
• Understand the technical behavior of the system, architecture, software requirements with an aptitude to identify product defects in all phases of development.
• Lead development of solutions that have significant improvements of processes and test development with aptitude for continue improvement.
• Work with the Project Management Office to coordinate dry runs and formal verification activities as required
• Collaborate with technical engineering teams, mentor junior test engineers.

• Conducted software and producted hardware-in-loop testing and created model and prototypes
• Reviewed MATLAB/Simulink models to ensure that all software meets quality standards
• Documented and participated in the documentation of the software including verification test plans and reports
• Implemented different software testing techniques in Python and Matlab to increase test coverage in both automation and manual testing.
• Analyzed the technical behavior of the system, architecture, software requirements with an aptitude to identify product defects in all phases of development.
• Led development of solutions that have significant improvements of processes and development with aptitude for continue improvement.
• Worked with the Project Management Office to coordinate dry runs and formal verification activities as required
• Collaborated with technical engineering teams, mentor junior test engineers.
• Developed the verification test methods to evaluate performance metrics of complex, electromechanical medical systems

Projects:
Control of Active Metamaterial:
• Proposed and designed a feedback/forward controller to spatiotemporal modulate the metamaterial’s stiffness using MATLAB
• Configured and analyzed wave propagation in the controlled system with %15 variable stiffness using MATLAB/COMSOL
• Studied and validated wave propagation experimentally using piezo sensors/actuators, hardware-in-the-loop, Simulink & dSPACE
• Analyzed the real-time data and investigated the nonreciprocity feature of the controlled system using MATLAB/Simulink

Closed-Loop Control of Anesthesia
• Proposed and advanced a medical device controller with %20 drug consumption reduction in anesthesia using Python
• Optimized and trained the adaptive multi-critic neuro-fuzzy controllers coefficients using Python
• Designed an optimal and adaptive controller for automation in anesthesia with no overshoot using Python

Moving Robot:
• Analyzed and compared PID and MPC controllers’ effects on the stability of a flexible robot using MATLAB
• Developed and designed arm robot gripper to detect different types of fish using machine learning/Python

Control of active baffles
• Innovated and introduced a smart fluid tank to eliminate the %99 of fluid movements within 0.01s using FEA/MATLAB
• Presented a robust nonlinear controller to stabilize the fluid movement using feedback linearization techniques
• Compared the designed feedback controller with the available products and showed the %30 more efficiencies of it using MATLAB 

Acoustics wave manipulation:
• Developed and initiated a metasurface for complete phase modulation using MATLAB/COMSOL
• Presented and investigated a methodology for broad-band sound attenuators in air-permeable structures
• Developed a theory-simulation method to measure the acoustic properties of metamaterials using MATLAB/COMSOL

Coordinator of Piezoactive System Laboratory (PSL), (2020-2022)
Published 7 journal papers and 5 conference papers.

Instructor of the following courses: 
Advanced Dynamics,
Mechatronics, 
Measurement Lab,

PDE controllers for Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM):
•Examined and compared the effects of different PDE controllers on AFM using C++
•Presented and simulated an ODE feedback controller to eliminate the vibrations of AFM in 0.001s using C++
•Introduced and implemented a Lyapunov-based boundary controller to %99 stabilize the movement of AFM using C++

Control of Coronary Artery Model:
•Designed and evaluated chaos controller to reduce the error of coronary artery system to %1 using MATLAB/Simulink
•Developed a sliding mode model reference, adaptive controller, for the coronary artery's nonlinear model using Matlab/Simulink

Fluid-Structure Vibrations:
•Investigated and analyzed the vibrations of micropolar membranes in contact with fluid using C++
•Monitored and interpreted rotor-shafts behavior under the influence of fluid forces using MATLAB

Published 3 journal papers and 1 conference paper

Instructor of the following courses:
Automatic Control, 
Dynamics of Machinery,
Vibrations,
Dynamic and Vibrations Lab,
Mechanisms Design,

Damage Detection on Gas Turbin
• Modeled and redesigned an 8000kg gas turbine with Catia and rebuilt  the model in Solidworks
• Simulated the model of the gas turbine by SolidWorks and ANSYS with different loads
• Analyzed the damages on the system and determined the effects of the cracks on the system's failure
• Presented a SolidWorks workshop to improve the knowledge of the company's staff

Solenoid Valves Modification
• Research on different available FEA software including ANSYS, Fluent, SolidWorks's modules & Comsol Multiphysics 
•Modified an available solenoid valve and documented the steps of it
• Calculated and Analyzed the solenoid valve flow rate using SolidWorks–Flow simulation
•  Compared the results of the modified valve with the original one, and showed performance improvement by %20
